name: Flowers of Sadism
body:
School transmutation [pain]; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 1, magus 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a sap)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous, see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You focus on the target and cause many painful bruises to form on the target. They take 1d6 points of nonlethal damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) and take a -2 penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and ability checks until the creature no longer has nonlethal damage, from any source. A successful Fortitude save halves the nonlethal damage and negates the penalty.
